entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: Uncial 047 is a Greek uncial manuscript of the New Testament Gospels, written on vellum. It is designated by the siglum 047 in the Gregory-Aland numbering of New Testament manuscripts, and ε 95 in the von Soden numbering of New Testament manuscripts. It was formerly designated by Hebrew letter ב.
